title: WoW bots have taken over the economy

posts.cooked:
Reports bots weeks ago and still see the same ones farming away in the same pathway day after day, all day long.

Blizzard have surrendered to the bots? Since Blizzard either refuse or unable to defeat the bots, Blizzard should just legitimize bots so everyone can use it to automate farming rather than punishing legitimate players by making their loot worthless and rewarding bots with multiple fold return on investment before (if they ever) see any action taken on them.
